decisions.reason: It remained a standalone marketed offer through 2024 and fits the firm's data-driven platform strategy, so with shared capabilities and low incremental carrying cost it is a strong option to retain.

Its reduced visibility by 2024 suggests only moderate standalone traction, but as an electricity-focused calculator close to the core offer it can still be kept as a relatively low-cost platform module while demand potential is not fully exhausted.

Although it was no longer promoted on its own page in 2024, it appears strategically complementary to the firm's integrated tariff and market-process tools, making it worth keeping open given likely low maintenance cost.
